Kino kirango ekiva ewa Allah n’Omubaka We, eri abo be mwakola nabo endagaano, mu bagatta ebintu ebirala ku Allah.
(Kati muweereddwa e ddembe ddembe) kale mutambule mu nsi e bbanga lya myezi ena, era mukimanye nti mazima ddala mmwe temuyinza kulemesa Allah, era ddala, nga bulijjo Allah aswaza abakaafiiri.

Era kuno kulangirira okuva eri Allah n’Omubaka We, okuteekwa okutuusibwa eri abantu, ku lunaku olukulu olwa Hijja, nti mazima Allah amenyeewo endagaano zonna ezaakolebwa n'abo abagatta ku Allah ebintu ebirala, n’Omubaka We bwatyo azimenyeewo, naye singa mwenenya ekyo ky'ekirungi gyemuli, wabula singa mugaana mumanye nti mazima mmwe temusobola kulemesa Allah, era (ggwe MuhammadI) abo abaakaafuwala bawe amawulire ag’ebibonerezo ebirumya.

Okuggyako abo be mwakola nabo endagaano mu Bamusinzabibumbe, oluvanyuma ne batamenya katundu konna mu ndagaano eyo, era ne batayamba muntu yenna abalwanyisa (abo) mubajjulize endagaano yaabwe okutuusa ekiseera kyabwe lwe kiggwaako, anti mazima ddala Allah ayagala nnyo abamutya.

Emyezi egy'emizizo bwegiggwaako, mutte abo abagatta ebirala ku Allah, wonna we mubagwikiriza,era mubawambe, era mubataayize, era mubateege mu buli kkubo, kyokka bwe beenenya, ne bayimirizaawo esswala, ne batoola Zzaka, olwo nno mubaleke, anti mazima Allah Musonyiyi, Musaasizi.

Singa omuntu yenna mu abo abagatta ku Allah ebintu ebirala akusaba okumuwa obubudamu, bumuwe, kimuyambe okuwulira Ebigambo bya Allah, oluvannyuma mutuuse mu kifo w'abeerera mu mirembe, ekyo nno lwa kuba nti mazima bo bantu abatamanyi.

Kisoboka kitya okubaawo endagaano wakati w’abagatta ku Allah ebintu ebiralala, ne wakati wa Allah ne Omubaka We! Mpozzi abo be mwakola nabo endagaano mu kifo awali Omuzikiti Ogw’emizizo, kale ebbanga lye bamala nga beesimbu gye muli nammwe muteekwa okubeera abeesimbu gyebali, mazima Allah ayagala abamutya.

Ngeri ki (bwe wayinza okubaawo e ndagaano wakati wa mmwe nabo) so nga bwe baba babawangudde tebafa ku ndagaano wadde oluganda lwe mulina nabo, babasiimiikiriza n’ebigambo byabwe, so nga emitima gyabwe tegiri nammwe nga ate abasinga obungi mu bo, boonoonyi.
Batunda Ebigambo bya Allah omuwendo ogwa layisi (ku nsi) ekyabaviirako okuziyiza (abantu) ku Kkubo lya Allah, mazima bo bibi ebyo bye baali bakola.
Tebafa ku Mukkiriza yenna k'ebe ndagaano oba oluganda, era abo be baasukka ensalo (za Allah).

Naye (awamu n'ekyo) bwe baba beenenyezza (ne bava ku bikolwa ebyo) ne bayimirizaawo esswala ne bawa Zzaka, olwo nno baba bafuuse baganda bammwe mu Ddiini, era bulijjo tunnyonnyola mu bulambulukufu Ebigambo Byaffe eri abantu abamanyi (abeegasa nabyo).

(Wabula ate) bwe bamenya ebirayiro byabwe, oluvannyuma lw'endagaano gye baakola, ne bajerega Eddiini ya mmwe, olwo nno mulwanyise abakungu mu bukaafiiri, anti mazima bo, tebakuuma birayiro, balyoke beekomeko.

Kiki ekibagaana okulwanyisa abantu abamenya endagaano zaabwe, ne baagala n’okugoba Omubaka (mu Makka), ate nga bo bennyini be baabasosonkereza omulundi ogwasooka, abaffe mutya batye, Allah y'asaanira okuba nga mumutya bwe muba nga ddala muli Bakkiriza.
Mubalwanyise, Allah ababonereze n’emikono gyammwe, era abakkakkanye era mmwe abataase ku bo, aweweeze ekyo ekiri mu mitima gy'Abakkiriza.
Era amalewo obukyayi bw’emitima gyabwe, era Allah akkirize okwenenya kw’oyo gw'aba ayagadde, bulijjo Allah Muyitirivu Wa kumanya, Mugobansonga.

Abaffe, musuubidde okuba nga mulekebwa (ne mutagezesebwa), Allah abe nga amanya abo abaalafuubana mu mmwe (olw'Eddiini), ne bateeteerawo wa mukwano yenna atali Allah, oba Omubaka We, oba Abakkiriza, bulijjo Allah amanyidde ddala ebyo bye mukola.

Abagatta ku Allah ebintu e birala tebakkirizibwa kuzimba mizikiti gya Allah, nga nabo bennyini beewaako obujulizi nti bakaafiiri, abo emirimu gyabwe gyonna mifu, era nga Muliro mwe bagenda okutuula obugenderevu.
Mazima ddala azimba emizikiti gya Allah, y'Oyo akkiriza Allah n’Olunaku lw'Enkomerero, n’ayimirizaawo esswala, n'atoola Zzaka, era n’atatya okuggyako Allah, abo nno be b'okubeera mu baluŋŋamu.

Muddira mutya okuwa ba Hajji amazzi n’okulabirira Omuzikiti Ogw’emizizo ne mukyenkanya n'oyo akkiriza Allah n’Olunaku lw'Enkomerero era n'alafuubana mu kuweereza mu Kkubo lya Allah! Tebayinza kwenkana mu Maaso ga Allah, era bulijjo Allah taluŋŋamya bantu beeyisa bubi.
Abo abakkiriza, ne basenguka, era ne balafuubana mu kuweereza mu Kkubo lya Allah nga bakozesa emmaali yaabwe n'emyoyo gyabwe, be basinga amadaala agaawaggulu ewa Allah, era abo, bo be b'okwesiima.
Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe abasanyusa nga bw'agenda okubawa okusaasira, n’okusiima ebiva Gy'ali, era abawe Ejjana, mwe balifunira ebyengera ebitakoma.
Baakuzibeeramu olubeerera, mazima Allah Yekka y'alina empeera ensukkulumu.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza, bakadde bammwe ne baganda bammwe, temubafuulanga mikwano gyammwe egy'omunda, kavuna bakulembeza obukaafiiri ku bukkiriza, oyo yenna mu mmwe abafuula mikwano gye ab'omunda, abo nno be beeyisa obubi.

Gamba nti bakadde bammwe n’abaana bammwe, ne baganda bammwe, ne be mwafumbiriganwa nabo, n’aboluganda lwa mmwe, n’ebyobugagga bye mukuŋŋaanya, n’ebyobusuubuzi bye mutya okudiba kwabyo, n’amayumba agabasanyusa, ebyo byonna bwe biba nga bye mwagala ennyo okusinga Allah n’Omubaka We, n’okulafuubana okuweereza mu Kkubo lye, olwo nno mulindirire okutuusa Allah lw'anaaleeta Ekiragiro Kye, era Allah taluŋŋamya bantu boonoonyi.

Mazima Allah yabataasa mu bifo bingi, ne ku lunaku lw'olutalo lwe Hunayini, obungi bwammwe bwe bwabasigula ne butabagasa kintu kyonna. Ensi yabafundirira awamu n’obugazi bwayo n’ekyaddako mwakyuka ne mudduka.
Oluvannyuma Allah yassa obuteefu ku Mubaka We, ne ku Bakkiriza era n'assa amagye ge mutaalaba, era n'abonereza abo abaakaafuwala. Era nga bulijjo empeera y’abakaafiiri bw'etyo bw'eba.
Oluvannyuma lw'ekyo Allah akkiriza okwenenya kw'oyo gw'aba ayagadde, era bulijjo Allah Musonyiyi, Musaasizi.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza (mukimanye nti), mazima abagatta ku Allah ebintu ebirala bajama, tebasembereranga Omuzikiti Ogw’emizizo oluvanyuma lw’omwaka gwabwe guno. Bwe muba mutidde bwavu, Allah bw'anaaba ayagadde ajja kubagaggawaza nga aggya mu bigabwa Bye, anti mazima Allah Mumanyi nnyo Mugobansonga.

Mulwanyise abo abatakkiriza Allah, wadde Olunaku lw'Enkomerero era nga tebaziza ebyo Allah n’Omubaka We bye baafuula Haraamu. Era ne batagoberera Ddiini entuufu, nga bava mu abo abaaweebwa Ekitabo, okutuusa nga bawadde omusolo nga buli omu y'agweweera, balabike nga bakkakkanyiziddwa.

Abayudaaya baagamba nti Uzayiru mwana wa Allah, ate Abakulisitaayo ne bagamba nti Masiya mwana wa Allah, ekyo kigambo kyabwe kye boogera n’emimwa gyabwe, ne bifaanana ekigambo ky'abo abaakaafuwala olubereberye. Allah yabakolimira, bawugulwa batya (okuva ku mazima)!

Baafuula ba kabona baabwe n’Abasosodooti okuba abasinzibwa, ne baleka Allah. Mu ngeri y’emu ne Masiya mutabani wa Mariyamu baamufuula bwebatyo, so nga ate tebaalagirwa okuggyako okusinza Allah omu. Tewali kisinzibwa kyonna u butuufu okuggyako Yye, Musukkulumu nnyo kw'ebyo bye bamugattako.
Baagala okuzikiza ekitangaala kya Allah, nga bakozesa emimwa gyabwe, ne Allah takkiriza okuggyako okujjuza ekitangaala Kye, newaakubadde nga abakaafiiri tebaagala.
Allah y'Oyo eyatuma Omubaka We nga amuwadde obuluŋŋamu ne Eddiini entuufu. Bulyoke bukye enkya nga y'Eddiini ewangudde newaakubadde nga abagatta ku Allah ebintu ebirala tebakyagala.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza, mazima bangi mu Bakabona, n’Abasosodooti balya emmaali y’abantu mu bukyamu, era ne baziyiza abantu okutuuka ku Kkubo lya Allah. N’abo bonna abakuŋŋaanya zaabu ne ffeeza ne batabiwaayo mu Kkubo lya Allah, basanyuse n’ebibonerezo ebirumya ennyo.

Ku lunaku (e mmaali eyo) lw'e ryengerezebwa mu Muliro Jahannama, ebyenyi byabwe nembiriizi zaabwe n’emigongo gyabwe ne byokebwa nayo, (nga bwe bakomekkerezebwa nti) bino bye mweterekera, mukombe ku bukaawu bw'ebyo, bye mwaterekanga.

Mazima omuwendo gw'emyezi ewa Allah giri emyezi kkumineebiri, bwekityo bwekiri mu biwandiiko bya Allah, okuva ku lunaku Allah lwe yatonda eggulu omusanvu n'ensi. Ena ku gyo gya mizizo, eyo nno y’Eddiini ennambulukufu, temweyisanga bubi mu gyo, era mulwanyise abagatta ku Allah ebintu ebirala bonna, nga nabo bwe babalwanyisa mwenna, mumanye nti mazima Allah bulijjo abeera n’abamutya.

Mazima okuwaanyisa emyezi egy'emizizo kyongera bukaafiiri, babuzibwa nakyo abo abaakaafuwala nga bakkiriza okugirwaniramu mu mwaka, ate omwaka omulala nebagiziza, basobole okujjuza omuwendo gw'emyezi Allah gye yaziza, mu kukola ekyo ne baba nga bafuula Halaali Allah kye yafuula Haraamu. Ebikolwa byabwe ebibi bya balabikira okuba nga bye birungi, nga bulijjo Allah taluŋŋamya bantu bakaafiiri.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza mwaba ki! Bwe babagamba nti mufulume mulafuubane mu kuweereza mu Kkubo lya Allah, muwulira nga muzitoye ne musalawo kutuula ku ttaka, musazeewo kugenda na bulamu bwa nsi okusinga Enkomerero! naye obulamu bw'ensi bwe bugeraageranyizibwa ku bw'Enkomerero tebuba, okuggyako kantu katono nnyo.

Bwe mutagenda (ku lutalo) (Allah) agenda kubabonereza ebibonerezo ebirumya ennyo, ate asseewo abantu abalala mu kifo kyammwe, era temuyinza kumutuusaako kabi konna, nga bulijjo Allah Muyinza Wa buli kintu.

Bwe mutamutaasa (Nnabbi Muhammadi), mazima Allah yamutaasa mu kiseera abakaafiiri bwe baamufulumya nga y’omu ku babiri, we baabeerera mu mpuku, mu kiseera we yagambira munne nti: Tonakuwala, mazima Allah ali wamu naffe, awo nno Allah n'amussaako obutebenkevu Bwe, era n'amudduukirira n'eggye lye mutaalaba. Ekigambo ky'abo abaakaafuwala n’akifuula ekyawansi, so nga Ekigambo kya Allah kyo kye kyawaggulu, bulijjo Allah Ye Nnantakubwakumukono, Mugobansonga.
Mufulume n’ebyokulwanyisa ebitonotono oba ebizito, mulafuubane nga muweereza mu Kkubo lya Allah, nga mukozesa emmaali yammwe nemy’oyo gya mmwe, ekyo nno ky’ekirungi gyemuli, bwe muba nga mumanyi.

Singa byali byanfuna nga biri kumpi, nga n’olugendo lwangu, baalikugoberedde, naye olugendo lwabayitirirako era bajja kulayira Allah nga bagamba nti, singa twabadde tusobola twandigenze na mmwe, mu kwogera ekyo ne baba nga bazikiriza myoyo gyabwe, anti Allah amanyi nti mazima bo balimba.
Allah akusonyiwe (Ggwe Muhammadi, lwaki wabakkiriza okusigala n’otalinda kumala kumanyira ddala ab'amazima, era n’omanya abalimba.

Abo abakkiriza Allah n’Olunaku lw'Enkomerero, tebayinza kukusaba kubaggyako luwalo lwa kugenda kulafuubana mu Kkubo lya Allah, nga bakozesa emmaali yaabwe, n’emyoyo gyabwe, era Allah amanyidde ddala abo abamutya.

Mazima abo abatakkiriza Allah n’Olunaku lw'Enkomerero, be bakusaba okubakkiriza obutagenda ku lutabaalo, n’emitima gyabwe gibuusabuusa, bonna mu kubuusabuusa kwabwe mwe babeera nga tebayinza kusalawo.
Singa baali baagadde kugenda ku lutalo, baalirwetegekedde okwetegeka okwetaagisa, naye Allah teyayagala kugenda kwa bwe, n’olwekyo n’atabasobozesa, olwo nno ne balangirira nti, musigale n’abasigadde.

Singa baagendera mu mmwe, tebandibongedde okugyako bizibu, era bandibungeesezza eŋŋambo mu mmwe, nga babaagaliza akabi, ate nga ne mu mmwe mwandibaddemu ababawuliriza, Allah amanyi nnyo ebikwata ku bantu abeeyisa obubi.
Mazima baayagala dda okukuleetera akabi ne bakutabangulira ebintu, okutuusa amazima lwe gajja n’Ekigambo kya Allah ne kyeyoleka, nga nabo tebaagala.
Mu bo mulimu omuntu agamba nti, nsaba onzikirize nneme kugenda ku lutalo, era tonteeka mu kikemo, abange abo nno mu kikemo mwennyini mwe baagwa, mazima Omuliro Jahannama gwetoolodde abakaafiiri.
Bw'otuukibwako ekirungi, kibanakuwaza, ate bw’otuukibwako ekibi, bagamba nti, ffe ekyo twakirabirawo ne tukyekengera, olwo nno ne badda mu maka gaabwe nga basanyufu.
(Ggwe Muhammadi) gamba nti tewali kitutuukako okugyako Allah kye yatuwandiikako, Yye, Ye Mutaasa Waffe, Abakkiriza Allah Yekka gwe bateekwa okwesiga,

Gamba (ggwe Muhammadi) nti: Mulina kye musuubira okututuukako ekitali ekimu ku birungi ebibiri (okuwangula olutalo oba okuwangulwa netuyingira Ejjana), nga ate ffe tubalindiridde Allah abatuuseeko ebibonerezo okuva Gy'ali, oba abibatuseeko nga abiyisa ku mikono gyaffe, kale mulindirire naffe tulindirira wamu nammwe.

Gamba (ggwe Muhammadi) nti: Kamuweeyo mu mmaali yammwe mu ngeri ya kyeyagalire oba ey’obuwaze, (okugaba kwammwe okwo) tekugenda kukkirizibwa kuva gyemuli, anti mazima ddala mmwe muli abantu aboonoonyi.

Tewali kyagaanyisa kuwaayo kwabwe kukkirizibwa, okuggyako okuba nti, mazima ddala bo baajeemera Allah n’Omubaka We, era tewali lwe bagenda kusaala okuggyako nga bagayaavu, era tebawaayo okuggyako lwa buwaze.
Emmaali yaabwe n’abaana baabwe tebikwewuunyisa, anti mazima Allah ayagala kubabonereza nabyo mu bulamu obw'ensi, era batuuke okussa omukka ogusembayo nga bakaafiiri.
Era balayira Allah nti, mazima bo ba mu mmwe, naye si ba mu mmwe, mazima bo bantu batiitiizi.
Singa bafuna obuddukiro, oba empuku, oba ekifo aweekukumwa, bandidduse okugenda gye kiri nga baduma.
Ate mu bo mulimu abakusongamu emimwa ku nsonga ya saddaaka, bwe baweebwako basiima, ate bwe bataweebwa, olwo nno ne basunguwala.

Singa bamatira n'ekyo Allah ky'aba abalwadde n'Omubaka We ne bagamba nti: Allah Waffe atumala, Allah ajja kutuwa mu bigabwa Bye ebingi n’Omubaka We bwatyo, anti mazima ddala ffe ewa Allah gye tuyaayaanira okudda.

Mazima ddala Saddaaka (Zzaka) eweebwa abaavu, n’abanaku, n’abagikolako, n'abo emitima gyabwe egisikirizibwa, (abaakasiramuka), ne mu kununula abaddu, n’abo amabanja be gatuuse mu bulago, ne mu kulafuubana mu kuweereza mu Kkubo lya Allah, n’omutambuze, ebyo byonna nga y'engereka ya Allah, era bulijjo Allah amanyi nnyo, Mugobansonga.

Era mu bo, mulimu abo abanyiiza Nnabbi nga bagamba nti, yye awuliriza buli kimu. Gamba nti: Awuliriza lwa bulungi bwammwe, akkiriza Allah, era yeesiga Abakkiriza, era yye kya kusaasira eri abo abakkiriza mu mmwe, ate abo abanyiiza Omubaka wa Allah, bagenda kutuukwako ebibonerezo ebirumya.
Babalayirira Allah babasanyuse, so nga Allah n’Omubaka be basinga okusaanira okusanyusibwa singa (abantu abo) babadde Bakkiriza.
Abaffe, tebamanyi nti mazima ddala omuntu eyeesimba mu Allah n’Omubaka We, mazima wa kuyingizibwa Omuliro Jahannama, nga wa kugubeeramu bugenderevu, obwo bwe buswavu obuyitirivu.
Abannanfunsi beekengera okussibwako Essuula, nga ebategeeza ebiri mu mitima gyabwe, gamba (ggwe Nnabbi Muhammad nti), mugira mubiyita eby'olusaago, mazima Allah ajja kwanika ebyo bye mwekengera.
Singa obabuuza (lwaki bajerega Abakkiriza), bajja kugambira ddala nti: Mazima twabadde mu lwali na kuzannya, gamba (ggwe Muhammadi) nti: Allah, n’Ebigambo Bye n’Omubaka We, bye mwabadde mujerega!.

Temwetonda mazima mukaafuwadde oluvannyuma lw’Obukkiriza bwammwe, bwe tusonyiwa ekitundu ku mmwe (olw'okwetonda), tuba tulina okubonereza ekitundu ekirala ekiteetonze, olw'okuba nti mazima bo baali boonoonyi.

Abannanfuusi abasajja n’abannanfuusi abakazi be bamu, balagira okukola empisa embi, ne bagaana (abantu) okukola empisa ennungi, era bafunya e mikono gyabwe (bakodo) beerabira Allah naye n'abalekerayo, mazima abannanfuusi, be boonoonyi.

Abannanfusi abasajja n’abannanfusi abakyala, n’abakaafiiri, Allah yabalagaanyisa Omuliro Jahannama, baakugubeeramu obugenderevu, gwo gwe gw'okubamala era Allah yabakolimira era balissibwako ebibonerezo eby'olubeerera

Bafaananako nga abo abaaliwo olubereberye lwa mmwe, baali baamaanyi nnyo okusinga mmwe, era nga be basinza emmaali n’abaana, olwo nno ne beeyagala olw'ebyo bye baafuna nga nammwe bwe mweyagadde olw'ebyo bye mufunye, ng'abaabakulembera bwe beeyagala olw'ebyo bye baafuna, era ne mudda mu kukuba olwali nga bali lwe baalimu, abo nno emirimu gyabwe gyayonooneka ku nsi ne ku Nkomerero, era abo be b'okufaafaaganirwa.

Abaffe amawulire g'abo abaabakulembera tegaabatuukako! Abantu ba Nuuhu, n’aba 'Aadi, n’aba Thamuudu, n’abantu ba Ibraahiimu, n’abantu b’o mu kitundu ky'e Madiyana, n’abantu b'omubitundu ebyavuunikibwa (aba Nnabbi Luutu) Ababaka baabwe baabajjira n’ebigambo bya Allah ebinnyonnyofu, oluvannyuma lw'ebyo Allah si ye yabayisa obubi, naye bo bennyini be beeyisa obubi.

Ate Abakkiriza abasajja n’Abakkiriza abakazi, abamu mikwano gya bannaabwe, balagira okuyisa obulungi, ne baziyiza okuyisa obubi, era ne bayimirizaawo esswala ne batoola Zzaka, era ne bagondera Allah n’Omubaka We, abo Allah ajja kubasaasira. Anti mazima ddala Allah Nnantakubwakumukono, Mugobansonga.

Allah yalagaanyisa Abakkiriza abasajja, n’Abakkiriza abakazi Ejjana ezikulukutiramu emigga, baakuzibeeramu bugenderevu, era baliweebwa ebisulo ebirungi mu Jjana ez’olubeerera, nga n'ekisingira ddala, bagenda kufuna okusiima okuva ewa Allah, era ekyo kwe kwesiima okusukkulumu.
Owange ggwe Nnabbi, lwanyisa abakaafiiri, n’abannanfusi era obakaluubirize, era obuddo bwa bwe muliro Jahannama, era buddo bubi nnyo.

Balayira Allah nti tebabyogerangako, naye nga mazima baayatula ekigambo ky'obukaafiiri, olwo nno ne bafuuka abakaafiiri oluvannyuma lw'okuba nti baali Basiraamu, ne bagezaako nnyo okukola kye baali tebasobola kutuukiriza (eky'okutta Nnabbi), tewali kyabakozesa mpalana okuggyako okuba nti Allah n’Omubaka We baabagonnomolako ebigabwa bya Allah, kale nno singa beenenya kiba kirungi gyebali, naye bwe batakikola Allah agenda kubabonereza olubonereza oluluma ennyo ku nsi, ne ku Nkomerero, era nga tebalina ku nsi mukuumi yenna oba mutaasa.
Era mu bo mulimu abo abaalagaanyisa Allah nga bagamba nti, singa atuwa mu bigabwa Bye, mazima tujja kusaddaakako era tujja kubeerera ddala mu balongoofu.
Bwe yabawa ku bigabwa Bye, baabikodowalira, ne bava ku kiragaanye, mu kukola ekyo ne baba nga baava ku ndagaano.
N’olwekyo ekyaddirira Allah n'annyikiza obunnanfuusi mu mitima gyabwe, okutuusa ku Lunaku lwe balimusisinkana, olw'okuba nti baayawukana ku kye baalagaanyisa Allah, ne ku lw'ebyo bye baali balimbisa.
Abaffe tebaamanya nti mazima Allah amanyi ebyama byabwe n’emboozi zaabwe ez’olwatu, era nga mazima amanyidde ddala ebyekusifu!

Abo abavumirira abakozi b’obulungi mu Bakkiriza olw'okuwaayo saddaaka, era ne bavumirira n'abo abatasobola kufuna okuggyako akatono, ne kibatuusa n’okubajeeja, Allah abaziimuula era bagenda kussibwako ebibonerezo ebiruma.

K'obeegayiririre oba tobeegayiririra, ne bw'onaabeegayiririra emirundi nsanvu Allah tagenda kubasonyiwa, ekyo nno lwa kuba nti mazima bo, baawakanya Allah n’Omubaka We, era nga bulijjo Allah taluŋŋamya bantu boonoonyi.

Abaayawukana ku Nnabbi baasanyuka olw'okusigala nga batudde, nga baawukanye ku Mubaka Wa Allah, neb batamwa okulwana n'emmaali yaabwe, n’emyoyo gyabwe mu Kkubo lya Allah, era ne bagamba bannaabwe ti: Temugezaako ne mugenda mu bbugumu. Bagambe nti: Omuliro Jahannama gwe gusinga okwokya singa babadde bategeera.
Kale nno basaana baseke kitono (mu bulamu obw'ensi), ate bakaabe nnyo (ku Nkomerero), nga y'empeera gye bagenda okusasulwa olw'ebyo bye baali bakola.

Singa Allah anaakuzza eri ekibinja mu bo (e Madiina), ne bakusaba okufuluma (ku lutabaalo), bagambe nti temugenda kuddayo kufuluma nange, era temugenda kulwanyisa mulabe yenna nga muli nange, mazima mmwe mwasalawo obutagenda omulundi ogwasooka, kale mubeere n'abo abaanjawukanako.
Era tosaaliranga oyo yenna aba afudde mu bo, era toyimiriranga ku ntaana ye, anti mazima bo baajeemera Allah n’Omubaka We, era ne bafa nga boonoonyi.
Obungi bw'emmaali yaabwe n’abaana baabwe tebukwewuunyisa. Allah ky'agenderera mu byo kubabonereza kuno ku nsi, era batuuke okufa nga bali ku bukaafiiri.
Essuula bw'essibwa nga ebalagira nti mukkirize Allah, era mulafuubane mu kuweereza mu Kkubo lye nga muli n’Omubaka We, abagagga mu bo bakusaba obasonyiwe, ne bagamba nti, tuleke tubeere n’abatagenze.
Baasiima okubeera awamu n’abaasigala, emitima gyabwe ne gizibikirwa, ne baba nga tebasobola kutegeera.

Naye mazima Omubaka n’abo abakkiriza abali awamu naye balafuubana mu kuweereza mu Kkubo lya Allah nga bakozesa emmaali yaabwe, n’emyoyo gyabwe, era abo balina obulungi, era abo bo be balituuka ku buwanguzi.
Allah yabategekera Ejjana ezikulukutiramu emigga, baakubeeramu bugenderevu, ekyo nno kwe kwesiima okusuffu.

Abawalabu bannamalungu ne bajja eri Nnabbi nga beetonda, babe nga bakkirizibwa obutagenda ku lutalo, ate abo abaalimbisa Allah n’Omubaka We, bo baatuula butuuzi (awatali kuwa nsonga yonna), abo abaakaafuwala mu bo, bagenda kutuukwako ebibonerezo ebiruma ennyo.

Abanafu n’abalwadde, n’abo abatasobola kufuna kye bawaayo, tewali kibavunaanwa kasita baba nga bakola ku lwa Allah n’Omubaka We, abakozi b’obulungi (ng’abo) tewali w'oyita kubassaako musango, nga bulijjo Allah Musonyiyi, Musaasizi.

Era tewali musango ne kw'abo abakujjira obafunire engeri gy’obatwalamu ku lutalo, n'ogamba nti: Sirina ngeri gye mbatwalamu, ne bava w'oli nga amaaso gaabwe gakulukuta amaziga olw'ennaku y’okuba nti tebayinza kufuna kye bawaayo.
Mazima okuvunaana, kubeera kw'abo abakusaba obutagenda ate nga bagagga, baasalawo babe n'abo abasigadde, Allah n'assa envumbo ku mitima gyabwe, tebayinza kumanya (nsonga ntuufu).

(Abo abaabaawukanako ku lutalo lwe Tabuuki) bajja kubeetondera (nga balimba), bwe munaaba muzzeeyo gye bali bagambe (gwe Nnabbi Muhammadi) nti temwetonda tetujja kukkiriza kwetonda kwammwe, anti mazima Allah yatutegeeza ebibakwatako, Allah ajja kulaba ebikolwa byammwe n'Omubaka We ajja kubiraba, oluvannyuma muli baakuzzibwa eri Omumanyi w'ebyekwese n'ebyolwatu, olwo nno Allah alyoke abategeeze ebyo bye mwali mukola (ku nsi).

Bajja kubalayirira Allah bwe munaaba muzzeeyo gye bali muleme kubaako bye mubanenya, kale mubaleke anti mazima bo banyoomebwa nga n'obuddo bwabwe Muliro Jahannama nga y'empeera y'ebyo bye baali bakola.
Babalayirira balyoke babasiimiikirize naye bwe munaaba mukkiriza okusiimiikiriza kwabwe, mazima ye Allah takkiriza kusiimiikiriza kwa bantu aboonoonyi.
Bannamalungu be basinga obukaafiiri n'obunnanfuusi era be basinga obutamanya nsalo za Mateeka Allah ze yassa ku Mubaka We, Allah Mumanyi nnyo Mugobansonga.

Mu bannamalungu mulimu abo abalaba kye baba bawaddeyo kyonna mu Kkubo lya Allah nga kufiirwa era nga babaagaliza bizibu naye nga ebizibu bya kutuuka ku bo, (so si ku mmwe), Allah awulira nnyo era Muyitirivu wa kumanya.

Era mu bannamalungu mulimu abakkiriza Allah n'Olunaku lw'Enkomerero era nga ne bye baba bawaddeyo mu Kkubo lya Allah babibala nga bya kubatuusa ku kusiima kwa Allah n'Omubaka okubasabira (obulungi). Kituufu ebyo bye baba bawaddeyo bibatuusa ku kusiima kwa Allah, Allah ajja kubayingiza (Ejjana) ekifo ky'okusaasira Kwe. Anti mazima Allah Musonyiyi nnyo Musaasizi.

N'abo abaasookera ddala okukkiriza mu baasenguka okuva e Makkah ne ba Answari (abaataasa Nnabbi) n'abo abaabagoberera mu kukola obulungi, Allah yabasiima nabo ne bamusiima, era Allah yabateekerateekera Ejjana ezikulukutiramu emigga nga baakuzibeeramu olubeerera, okwo nno kwe kwesiima okusukkulumu.

Ne mw'abo ababeetoolodde mu bannamalungu mulimu abannanfuusi ne mu batuuze b'e Madiina mulimu abaagugubira ku bunnanfuusi, nga ggwe tobamanyi, ffe nno tubamanyi. Tujja kubabonereza emirundi ebiri (kuno ku nsi n'okubaswaza n'ebibonerezo by'omuntaana oluvannyuma lw'okufa), oluvanyuma baakuzzibwa eri ebibonerezo ebisuffu.

(Waliwo) N'abalala abakkiriza ebibi byabwe, baatabula emirimu emirungi n'emirala emibi. Ob'olyawo Allah ajja kubasonyiwa (olw'okwetonda kwabwe) anti mazima Allah Muyitirivu wa kusonyiwa era Muyitirivu wa kusaasira.

(Abo abeetonda mu bo) mu mmaali yaabwe ggyamu Saddaaka obatukuze era obalongoose nayo. Era basabire (Allah abasonyiwe) anti mazima okusaba kw'obasabira mirembe gye bali, Allah awulira nnyo era Mumanyi nnyo.
Tebamanyi nti mazima Allah Yye, yakkiriza okwenenya kwa baddu Be era nti yakkiriza Saddaaka era nti mazima Allah Yye y'akkiriza okwenenya era Omusaasizi ennyo.

Bagambe (Ggwe Nnabbi Muhammadi) nti mukole, Allah ajja kulaba emirimu gyammwe n’Omubaka We n’Abakkiriza era nga muli ba kuzzibwa eri Omumanyi w'ebitalabikako n'ebirabikako olwo alyoke abategeeze, ebyo bye mwali mukola.
(N'abalala mw'abo abaakwawukanako ku lutalo lw'e TabuukI) baalekerwa kusalawo kwa Allah, oba agenda kubabonereza oba alikkiriza okwenenya kwabwe. Mazima Allah Mumanyi nnyo Mugobansonga.

N'abo (Abannanfuusi) abaateekawo omuzikiti ogw'obulabe n’olwobukaafiiri, era n’olwokwawulayawula mu Bakkiriza n’olwokutegekera oyo eyalwanyisa Allah n'Omubaka We olubereberye, era bajja kulayirira ddala nti tetulina kigendererwa okuggyako obulungi, so nga Allah amanyi nti mazima bo balimbira ddala.

Togezanga n'oyimirira (Ggwe Nnabbi) okugusaaliramu, mazima omuzikiti ogwazimbibwa ku musingi ogw'okutya Allah okuviira ddala ku ntandikwa gw'oteekwa okusaalirangamu, mu muzikiti ogwo mulimu abasajja abaagala okwetukuza, anti bulijjo Allah ayagala abeetukuza.

Abaffe oyo eyatandika omusingi gw'ekizimbe kye ku lw'ekigendererwa ky'okutya Allah n'okusiima Kwe y'asinga obulungi oba oyo eyatandikawo omusingi gw'ekizimbe kye ku nsonda y'ekifunvu ne kimusuula mu Muliro Jahannama, Allah taluŋŋamya bantu beeyisa bubi.
Ekizimbe Abannanfusi kye baazimba kijja kusigala nga kya kubuusabuusa mu mitima gyabwe okutuusa okufa kwabwe, Allah Mumanyi nnyo Mugobansonga.

Mazima Allah yagula ku Bakkiriza obulamu bwabwe n'emmaali yabwe nga ddala agenda kubasasulamu Jjana olw'okuba nti balwana mu Kkubo lya Allah ne batta era nga nabo battibwa eyo nga Ndagaano gye yeekakasaako mu Tawulaati, mu Njiri ne mu Kulaani, ate ani ayinza okutuukiriza endagaano ye okusinga Allah! Kale nno musanyuke n'obuguzi bwe mugulaana era okwo kwe kwesiima okusukkulumu.

(Abagwa mu kiti ekyo) beebo abeenenyeza Allah abasinza Allah abatendereza Allah, abatambula mu nsi ku lw'okuweereza Allah abakutama ku maviivi ne bavunnama ku ttaka (nga basaala) abalagira empisa ennungi era abaziyiza amayisa amabi, era abeekuumira ku Mateeka ga Allah, era sanyusa Abakkiriza.
Nnabbi tekimugwanira wadde abakkiriza okwegayiririra abagatta ku Allah ekintu ekirala, ne bwe baba baaluganda olw'okumpi kasita kimala okubeeyolekerera ddala nti mazima bo ba mu Muliro.

Okwegayirira kwa Ibraahiimu ku lwa kitaawe tekyaliwo okuggyako olw'endagaano gye yamuwa, naye bwe yamala okukitegeera nti ddala mazima yye (kitaawe) mulabe wa Allah yamwegaana, (Ibraahiimu yalina okugezaako nga bw'asobola okwegayirira Allah asaasire kitaawe), anti Ibraahiimu olubeerera yali muyitirivu wa kusaba na kuloopa nsonga ze zonna ewa Allah era nga waakisa nnyo.
Era Allah teyali wa kubuza bantu oluvannyuma lw'okubaluŋŋamya okuggyako nga amaze okubannyonnyola ebyo bye bateekwa okwewala. Anti mazima Allah Mumanyi Wa buli kintu.
Mazima Allah bubwe obufuzi bw'eggulu (omusanvu) n'ensi, awa obulamu era natta, nga oggyeko Allah temulina mukuumi wadde omutaasa.

Mazima Allah yakkiriza okwenenya kwa Nnabbi n'okwa Bamuhaajiriina (abaasenguka) n'okwa Baanswaari (abaabudamya) abo abaamugoberera mu kiseera ekizibu oluvannyuma lw emitima gy'abamu ku bo okusemberera okukyuka, olwo nno n'abasonyiwa anti mazima Yye bulijjo Waakisa Musaasizi era y'akkiriza okwenenya.

Era yakkiriza okwenenya kw'abasatu abo abataagenda ku lutabaalo okutuusa ensi lwe yabafundirira awamu n'okubeera nga ngazi, nabo bennyini nebafundawalirwa olw'okweraliikirira, nebatuuka okulowooza nti tewali kuwona Allah okuggyako nga omuntu azze Gy'ali, oluvannyuma Allah yabaddiramu basobole okwenenya. Anti mazima Yye Allah akkiriza okwenenya era Musaasizi.
Abange mmwe abakkiriza mutye Allah era mubeere wamu n'abaamazima.

Kyali tekisaanira bantu b'e Madinah ne bannamalungu ababeetoolodde okwawukana ku Mubaka wa Allah (ku lutabaalo) n'okuba nti beeyagala okusinga bwe bamwagala, ekyo nno lwa kuba nti mazima bo tewali nnyonta wonna lw'ebaluma, wadde okukoowa, wadde enjala, nga bali mu kulafuubana okuweereza mu Kkubo lya Allah era tewali kigere kyonna, kye batambula ekinyiiza abakaafiiri, era tewali buzibu bwonna bwe batuusa ku mulabe, okuggyako nga kibawandiikibwako nga omulimu omulungi. Mazima ddala bulijjo Allah tayonoona mpeera ya bantu balongoosa.

Era tebawaayo kiweebwayo kyonna kitono oba kinene era tebamalaako lusenyi lwonna okuggyako nga kibawandikibwako nga kirungi. Olwo nno Allah alyoke abasasule e birungi ebisukkuluma kw'ebyo bye baakola.

Abakkiriza tebateekwa bonna kufuluma kugenda (kulafuubana mu Kkubo lya Allah) naye singa mu buli bantu muvaamu ekibinja ne bagenda bakuguka mu kumanya Eddiini olwo nno bagende babuulirire abantu baabwe nga bakomyewo gyebali ekyo nno kibasobozese okwekeka (ebitakkirizibwa).
Abange mmwe abakkiriza mulwanyise abakaafiiri abo ababaliraanye bateekwa bawulire obuzito obuva mu mmwe, era mukimanye nti mazima ddala Allah bulijjo abeera wamu n'abamutya.
Bulijjo essuula bw'eba nga essiddwa, mu bo mulimu abagamba nti: Ani mu mmwe (essuula) eno gw'eyongedde Obukkiriza, wabula bo Abakkiriza eba ebongedde Obukkiriza era baba bali mu ssanyu.
Naye abo abalina obulwadde mu mitima gyabwe ebongera bubi ku bubi bwabwe ne batuuka okufa nga bakaafiiri.
Abaffe tebakiraba nti mu buli mwaka bagezesebwa omulundi gumu oba ebiri, oluvannyuma ne bateenenya wadde okuba abeebuulirira.
Era essuula bw'eba essiddwa abamu batunula ku bannaabwe (nga bagamba nti): Abaffe, waliwo omuntu yenna abalaba? Olwo nno ne beemulula, Allah yakyusa emyoyo gyabwe kubanga bo bantu abatategeera.
Omubaka yabajjira nga ava mu mmwe mwennyini nga kimuzitoowerera nnyo ekyo ekibakaluubiriza abalumirwa nnyo, era eri Abakkiriza bonna Waakisa Musaasizi.
Wabula bwe bakwesamba, ggwe (Nnabbi Muhammadi) gamba nti: Allah ammala, tewali kisinzibwa mu butuufu okuggyako Yye, Yye Gwe nneesiga era Yye Ye Mufuzi wa Arishi eyeekitiibwa.
